name: 2.0.0-test-rc9 focused checklist
description: Only the changes made after Max completed all RC8 checks on an on-prem instance.

items.name: Reviewer details are filled in
items.description: Test: Sign in, open Review, choose Actions > Export release review, and look at Reviewer name and email. Export once, close the dialog, then open it again. Pass: ClawMax fills both fields from your signed-in profile when available. Your last entered details are remembered in this browser when the instance has no profile details.

items.name: Plugin pages fit on a phone
items.description: Test: On a phone, open Guardrails, Evals, Optimize, and Review. Switch Active, Archived, and Suggested; use every view button; expand a suggested item; and open the Review export dialog. Pass: The page never scrolls sideways. Text and details wrap, all four view buttons fit one row, card buttons stay visible, and the export buttons remain reachable.

items.name: RC9 starts cleanly
items.description: Test: Install or update to RC9, open the dashboard, restart it once, and reopen the same workspace. In System & Logs, confirm the version and plugin list. Pass: The dashboard reports 2.0.0-test-rc9, starts without a new error, keeps the workspace after restart, and shows only the plugins expected for that image.
